title: Tagged rendering pipeline in HalfEdgeMeshRuntime
description:
Extend HalfEdgeMeshRuntime to render per-tag with per-tag color, consuming the existing __tags slot populated by TagGeometryNode. Patches, DSL tag_geometry annotations, and any other per-vertex labeling gets visualized uniformly without shader forks or per-face color VBO hacks.

Implementation:
1. Tag-color registry on HalfEdgeMeshRuntime:
   - Explicit: setTagColor(String tag, Vector4f rgba)
   - Derived: stable hash of tag name when no explicit color (random tags still render distinctly)
2. At upload time (or on setTags call): partition the EBO into per-tag index ranges. Sort triangles by the tag that wins for their vertices (priority: most recently added / lowest-id wins on multi-tag vertices). Record (tagName, indexStart, indexCount) ranges. Untagged triangles form a trailing range rendered with the existing solidColor.
3. render() walks tag ranges: set solidColor from registry, glDrawElements for that range. Existing Lambert lighting applies as-is.
4. Flat unshaded mode reuses the existing meshUnlitShader program. setShaderMode(Lambert|Flat) flips which program draws.
5. New HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData field: per-tag index ranges list.

Not a shader change — no new uniforms, no new vertex attributes. Just partitioning the draw and varying solidColor per partition.
definition-of-done: setTags(Map<String, boolean[]>), setTagColor(String, Vector4f), clearTags(), setShaderMode() all work. Test: load a DSL, install two test tags (top/bottom spatial split), confirm mesh renders half-one-color half-other under Lambert; swap to Flat shader, confirm flat no-lighting. Untagged meshes still render solid-color as today.
testing-plan: (1) mvn compile passes. (2) Temporary debug hook in MeshNodeViewerScene installs 'top'/'bottom' tags after DSL load. Visually verify per-tag coloring. (3) Shift+P swaps shader mode; verify flat vs Lambert. (4) Remove debug hook and confirm no regression on plain DSL meshes.
